comment: Why did the subtitles say 'koba' when Ravi hugged his brother? Nobody says koba unless they are insulting someone or picking a street fight! He should say toran or toran-ya.
I loved the cinematography! The mountain scenes look fantastic. Subtitles were yellow.
In scene 3, the subtitles used 'baxu' for water. That word makes no sense. The audio clearly says 'dara-la'.
The episode was too short, when is episode 2 dropping?
